top_stories.title: Microsoft Entra News #162: passkeys become first MFA as Tenant Governance goes GA
top_stories.summary: Microsoft Entra is rolling out multiple identity changes including allowing users to register passkeys or passwordless sign-in as their first MFA method, while retiring SMS first-factor sign-in for Entra ID Free tenants. The update also includes the general availability of Tenant Governance, a feature relevant to enterprise identity administrators managing multi-tenant environments.

top_stories.title: Weak IAM affects up to 98% of cloud environments
top_stories.summary: Research finds weak IAM configurations affect up to 98% of cloud environments, with misconfiguration identified as a leading cloud security threat. CISA has mandated baseline cloud configuration standards to address issues including unrotated keys, exposed services, and logging gaps.

top_stories.title: Microsoft is killing off SMS authentication codes as AI makes phishing attacks even more dangerous
top_stories.summary: Microsoft is ending SMS-based two-factor authentication for IT admin logins to Microsoft Entra ID accounts starting February 1. This change is part of Microsoft's broader push toward passkey adoption as a more secure authentication method.

top_stories.title: Cyera's Oasis Security Buy Is All About AI Agent Control
top_stories.summary: Cyera acquired Oasis Security in a $1 billion deal to combine data security and identity management into a unified control plane for AI agents. The acquisition redefines privileged access management around dynamic business context rather than static roles, targeting the growing challenge of securing non-human identities and AI agents.

top_stories.title: Belgium's eID Authentication Opens Citizen Accounts to RCE
top_stories.summary: Belgium's national eID authentication system was found to contain severe vulnerabilities in a critical browser extension, resulting in full compromise of the trust framework and exposing citizen accounts to remote code execution. The flaws highlight systemic security risks in browser extension-based authentication mechanisms used in national digital identity infrastructure.

news.title: Hacker claims 3.6 million Azure account records stolen from major companies
news.summary: A threat actor claims to have stolen 3.6 million Azure account records from multiple Fortune 500 companies by exploiting compromised credentials. The attacker is selling employee databases allegedly extracted from Microsoft Azure infrastructure, highlighting credential-based access control failures.

news.title: Certighost and the Privilege Hiding in Your Certificate Authority
news.summary: A vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-54121 allows a standard domain user to escalate privileges to Domain Controller level by exploiting an Enterprise Certificate Authority. The article addresses standing privilege, implicit trust, and PKI as Tier 0 identity infrastructure, all core PAM and zero trust concepts.

news.title: Attackers exploit patched macOS Screen Sharing flaw to deploy cryptominer
news.summary: A patched macOS vulnerability (CVE-2026-65400) in Screen Sharing is being actively exploited to bypass authentication and gain root access without valid credentials. Apple has released fixes in macOS Sequoia 15.7.9, Sonoma 14.8.9, and Tahoe 26.6.1 to address the authentication bypass flaw.

news.title: How MCP Servers Can Expose Enterprise Secrets
news.summary: MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers pose security risks by exposing enterprise secrets through plaintext configuration files, over-permissioned access, and prompt injection vulnerabilities. The protocol, which enables AI agents to access tools and data, can create unmonitored access control gaps before security teams are aware the servers are running.

news.title: IAM Compliance Requirements and Best Practices
news.summary: This article provides a guide on IAM compliance requirements, covering relevant regulations and best practices for managing identity and access controls across users, applications, infrastructure, and non-human identities. It addresses the shift from periodic access reviews to continuous, evidence-backed verification methods suitable for audit purposes.

news.title: Chrome DevTools Technique Enables Authenticated Session Hijacking in Live Windows Browsers
news.summary: Researchers have detailed a post-exploitation technique using Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) to hijack authenticated browser sessions in live Chrome and Edge processes on Windows. The attack allows access to cookies and authenticated sessions without needing to extract credentials, requiring only existing code execution on the host.

news.title: CTM360 Uncovers Over 3,000 Recruitment Phishing URLs Using Browser-in-the-Browser (BitB) Credential Traps
news.summary: CTM360 identified over 3,000 phishing URLs using Browser-in-the-Browser techniques to steal Google and Facebook credentials through fake recruitment pages. The campaign includes real-time MFA prompt relay capabilities, effectively bypassing multi-factor authentication protections.

news.title: How Identity Drives MSP Profitability: An Analyst’s Perspective
news.summary: Cisco is positioning its Secure MSP Center and Duo platform as identity-first security tools for managed service providers serving SMB and midmarket customers. The piece frames identity-based security as a driver of recurring revenue and operational simplification for MSPs looking to reduce vendor sprawl.

news.title: Leading SAP GRC Tools: 2026
news.summary: The article reviews leading SAP GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) tools for 2026, focusing on software that controls access and authorization within SAP environments. The coverage addresses who can approve payments and create vendors, touching on access control and segregation of duties concepts relevant to IAM and identity governance within SAP ecosystems.

news.title: Microsoft 365 backup gap leaves customers responsible after ransomware
news.summary: Microsoft does not guarantee restoration of customer data to a specific known-good point after ransomware attacks affecting Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and Azure services. The article highlights that stolen identities enabling such attacks make independent, immutable backup critical, with Entra ID identity data specifically noted as a recovery gap.

news.title: Microsoft is urging administrators to prioritise Entra ID over Active Directory
news.summary: Microsoft is urging IT administrators to prioritize Microsoft Entra ID as the strategic identity platform for modern workloads over on-premises Active Directory. The recommended migration path is incremental, covering authentication, access decisions, and related identity functions.

news.title: RISE with SAP and the SAP IDM Sunset: Two Deadlines, One Identity Strategy
news.summary: SAP Identity Management is approaching end of life, creating a dual deadline challenge for organizations also migrating to RISE with SAP. The article covers migration strategies, key risks, and planning considerations for identity governance during this transition period.

news.title: North Korean Remote Workers Are Infiltrating Government and Businesses: How to Expose Them Before Hiring
news.summary: North Korean IT workers are obtaining legitimate employment at companies and government agencies, gaining authorized access to internal systems through normal hiring processes. The FBI is investigating a case involving a North Korean remote IT worker who gained legitimate credentials and system access, highlighting insider threat risks related to identity verification and access management processes.

news.title: Attackers Exploit SharePoint Authentication Bypass After Public PoC Release
news.summary: Threat actors are actively exploiting CVE-2026-55040, a critical Microsoft SharePoint authentication bypass vulnerability with a CVSS score of 9.1, following the release of public proof-of-concept code. The flaw stems from weak authentication and was patched by Microsoft in its July 2026 Patch Tuesday updates.

news.title: The Customer Identity And Access Management Solutions Landscape, Q3 2026 Is Live
news.summary: Forrester has published its Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) Solutions Landscape report for Q3 2026. The report identifies three primary drivers shaping the CIAM market, including AI agents as a new identity type within CIAM solutions.

news.title: The Forrester Customer IAM (CIAM) Landscape Is Live
news.summary: Forrester has published its 2026 Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) Landscape report. The report identifies three primary drivers shaping the CIAM market, including AI agents as a new identity type within CIAM frameworks.

news.title: Azure IoT gets TLS 1.3, passwordless provisioning, and secure updates
news.summary: Microsoft is rolling out three Azure IoT security updates including TLS 1.3 support for IoT Hub and managed-identity authentication between Device Provisioning Service and IoT Hub, currently in public preview. The managed-identity authentication component touches IAM concepts but the updates are primarily focused on IoT infrastructure security rather than identity and access management directly.

news.title: Amazon S3 adds additional policy details to access denied error messages
news.summary: Amazon S3 has updated its HTTP 403 Access Denied error messages to include specific AWS IAM and AWS Organizations policy ARNs for same-account and same-organization requests. This change allows administrators to more quickly identify which policy is denying access without additional investigation.

news.title: Keeper Security Issues Cybersecurity Guidance for Education IT Teams As Students Return to Campus
news.summary: Keeper Security has issued cybersecurity guidance targeting education IT teams for the back-to-school period. The guidance addresses AI-powered phishing, deepfake impersonations, and unmanaged machine identities as security concerns for school districts and universities.

news.title: How AWS IAM role manager rethinks the starting point for IAM roles
news.summary: AWS introduced an IAM role manager tool that rethinks how developers initiate and configure IAM roles when building new applications on AWS. The tool aims to simplify the starting point for IAM role creation, addressing the common requirement that AWS services acting on a user's behalf need properly configured IAM roles.

news.title: Gunra Ransomware Gang Exploits Fortinet Flaws, Bypasses MFA
news.summary: The Gunra ransomware gang is exploiting Fortinet vulnerabilities and bypassing MFA as part of its attack chain against critical infrastructure targets. The group uses leaked Conti ransomware code alongside unpatched flaws in Fortinet firewall and VPN appliances to gain access.

news.title: 'GhostJacking' Exposes Identity Governance Gaps in AI Agents
news.summary: New research has identified an attack technique called "GhostJacking" that exploits identity governance gaps in AI agents by manipulating security alerts and blocked events. The attack method demonstrates how threat actors can hijack AI agents by leveraging security notification mechanisms against them.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian man Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges for hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The attacks involved credential-based intrusions targeting Snowflake customer accounts, resulting in data theft including over 100 million AT&T customer records.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA released a postmortem report on a data breach in which a contractor accidentally exposed dozens of internal CISA credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, in a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management failures and access control gaps, with security experts drawing lessons applicable to all organizations managing sensitive credentials and cloud access keys.

news.title: Scattered Spider Hackers Plead Guilty on Day 1 of Trial
news.summary: Two members of the Scattered Spider cybercrime group pleaded guilty in the UK to charges related to an August 2024 cyberattack on Transport for London. Scattered Spider is known for social engineering and identity-based attacks, including SIM swapping and MFA bypass techniques used to compromise enterprise systems.
